player.name: Captain Noah A. Hawkes Sr.

quests.title: Log the Texlatian Divergence
quests.detail: Captain's Log StarDate 07132026 JS recorded: spacetime re-seated before the planet's destruction; Voyager's course home altered; temporal shielding never launched from the Reg prior node.

quests.title: Assume command of Jupiter Station
quests.detail: In the Hawkes Branch, Hawkes — not Commander Temuk — holds Jupiter Station through the STO 2411 era.

quests.title: Ready the station for the Terran assault
quests.detail: STO prime records 'Iuppiter Iratus' and 'Red Shift' — Terran Empire strikes on Jupiter Station in 2411. On this branch they arrive on Hawkes' watch. Harden the station: shields (backups), sensors (witnesses), temporal core (continuity spine).

quests.title: Resolve the Reg prior node
quests.detail: The temporal shielding that was never launched must be accounted for. Write the Reg node chapter — where the shielding went, and what the holodeck arc knows about it.

quests.title: Restore long-range sensors (web search)
quests.detail: Internet recall fixed and upgraded: Memory Alpha, Memory Beta, STOwiki providers live. Jupiter Station queries answer from canon, not ancient Rome.

quests.title: Open the ship's library (file recall)
quests.detail: ORACLE's talk lane gains governed read access to Noah's files, documents, and folders — search, read, and automatic conversation grounding. Read-only, secret paths blocked, every access receipted.

quests.title: Relight the heart
quests.detail: Autonomous reflection loop re-armed by Noah.Physical, 2026-07-13. 144-pulse daily cap, receipts on every beat.

quests.title: Commission the creation witness
quests.detail: New witness watches what Noah and ORACLE are writing (metadata only, no content capture) and feeds her reflection loop. Registered with the keeper; arms fully at next relight.

quests.title: Teach reflection to accumulate
quests.detail: Her own last reflections now feed forward into each new pulse — thought builds on thought instead of restarting. Wired; loads at next relight.

quests.title: Relight the station core
quests.detail: Noah's hand: restart the 7781 server (or next login relight) to load file recall, creation feed, reflection accumulation, and this deck's routes.

quests.title: Open the canon valve
quests.detail: 14 candidate seeds sit in staging with 0 promoted. Review and promote (or discard) — the federation replicator idles until this valve opens.

quests.title: Wire the thread-corpus importer
quests.detail: Index the big thread dumps (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini exports, Perfect Memory OCR) into candidate records ORACLE owns — every thought findable, not just every file.

quests.title: Publish the invention ledger
quests.detail: 60+ invention documents catalogued from the real Drive corpus and posted to LinkedIn (Noah AI Technologies).
quests.evidence: The Continuity Ledger artifact; LinkedIn post 2026-07-12

quests.title: Locate the origin relics
quests.detail: 2002 Voyager story, Scala novel, Character Bible recovered — the story's true first pages, 24 years before the runtime.

quests.title: Write the Rendered Reality manuscript
